Quick answer

What are Zonar OS and HALU? Zonar OS™ is Neural Horizons AI's verification layer. It reconciles your order, invoice and delivery records, proves every mismatch with the source row, and releases only verified findings. HALU™ is the intelligence agent that turns those findings into briefings for department heads. People approve every action that matters.

Who is it for? Enterprises and SMEs in the UAE and GCC that run on ERP and CRM systems and want to find revenue leakage, stop silos between departments, and deploy agentic AI with human oversight.

First live module: Reconciliation Audit

Every department keeps records.
Nobody checks them against each other.

SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce. They run the business. They do not tell you that an order was delivered and never invoiced, or that an invoice does not match its order. Zonar OS sits on top of what you already run and audits it. Nothing gets replaced.

The Reconciliation Audit is our first live module. It checks orders, invoices and deliveries. The same method, verify first and then brief, applies to every industry we serve. See below.

📄

Orders vs invoices

Orders where the invoice does not match what was ordered or delivered.

🚚

Deliveries vs invoices

Revenue that left the building and never reached a bill.

🔗

Invoices vs orders

Charges with nothing behind them. Each one is traced to its row.

Built to be trusted

An agent your CFO
can sign off.

Autonomy without controls is how AI projects get cancelled. People stay in the loop, and the limits are the product.

✅

Verified data only

HALU reads completed, audited runs. If a run is not verified, it is refused. There is no partial answer.

🔎

Traced to the source

Every finding carries its file, row and record IDs. Nothing in a briefing is unreferenced.

✍️

Signed boundaries

The readiness gate stays closed until the data, the definitions and a boundary signed by your business owner are in place.

🔒

Locked to your workspace

Least-privilege access, one client per credential, and an audit trail of every run and every read.

How it's built

Human-in-the-loop agentic AI
you can audit.

Zonar OS and HALU combine a deterministic reconciliation engine with a grounded large language model (LLM) layer. The engine decides what is true. The language layer explains it. People approve what matters.

🧑‍💼

Human in the loop

HALU drafts, flags and escalates. Your people approve every action that matters. Pre-approved playbook actions run only inside limits a human set, and every one is logged.

⚙️

A deterministic core

Reconciliation is rule-based and repeatable. The same files give the same findings. No language model decides what is true.

🔗

Grounded answers (RAG)

Ask HALU uses retrieval-augmented generation over verified findings. It retrieves the evidence first, then answers from it, with the source rows. No evidence, no answer.

🧠

An LLM that explains, not invents

The LLM writes the plain-language briefing. It cannot introduce a fact the evidence does not carry, and every statement keeps its source reference.

🛡️

Guardrails against hallucination

Verified-only inputs, source-row citations, refusal when evidence is missing, an optional readiness gate and a decision log of every delivery and every hold.

🔐

Governance and security

Microsoft Entra ID sign-in, role-based access control, one client per credential, tenant isolation, a full audit trail, and backup and recovery.

FAQ

Common questions.

What is the difference between HALU™ and Zonar OS™?+
Zonar OS™ is the reconciliation and verification platform. It matches your operational files against each other and flags every discrepancy with evidence. HALU™ reads what Zonar OS™ has verified and turns it into briefings and answers. Zonar OS™ checks. HALU™ explains.
Which should I start with?+
They go in together, because HALU™ answers only from what Zonar OS™ has verified. We start with one use case, in whichever department feels the gap most, on top of your existing systems with no rip-and-replace, and extend from there.
Can HALU™ run without Zonar OS™?+
Yes, in a lighter form. HALU™ Lite starts on your existing CRM, analytics and communication tools. For briefings built on verified findings, with every statement traced to a source row, HALU™ works from Zonar OS™, which is why we deploy them together.
Does it replace our ERP or CRM?+
No. It sits on top of them and works from the data they already produce, today through file exports. Questions? support@neuralhorizonsai.com
Is it available now?+
Yes. We scope each rollout with you and handle setup, training and onboarding. The Reconciliation Audit module in Zonar OS™ is currently a pilot programme.
How quickly can they be deployed?+
It depends on your data and on how quickly the people involved can agree definitions. We scope the timeline with you after the first conversation.
Do you work with businesses outside the UAE?+
Yes. Neural Horizons AI serves clients globally. The products are cloud-based and deploy into any business regardless of location. We have clients across the Middle East, Europe and beyond.
